name: pana-ring-probe
description: Structured log, probe of what a Panasonic lens sends (GitHub issue #3, aperture ring): event pana_stat at set_stat_pana 0x7E5234D7, a record when l_stat_pana or the lens's av_effect changes (with l_func_flag_pana and the Panasonic flag byte 0x604F7F64); event pana_func at set_func_flag_pana 0x7E523495, a record when l_func_flag_pana changes (with the lens id word 0x604F67B0). Both through log-menu-3's log_chg, gates at 0x7E4FD0A8 and 0x7E4FD0B0 in the log's state block. Events pana_pk84_0/1 (status parser 0x7E523915, command 84: stat and the 14 bytes after it) and pana_pk34_0/1 (parser 0x7E52128F, command 34: the 3 skipped bytes, stat and the 11 bytes after it): a record pair when the 16 bytes change, at most one pair per 0.5 s per command, keys at 0x7E4FD0B8 and 0x7E4FD0BC, times at 0x7E4FD300 and 0x7E4FD304. Four hooks in stock bytes of segment 1, their routines in segment 1. Needs the specs of data/builds/peaking-mf.json before it: every expect is a byte string of that build. It puts the build id 8bf70fea0397b1f2 of data/logdict/events.json into the block header. DEBUG builds only. See experiments/2026-11-22-pana-aperture-ring/NOTES.md and docs/reference/logging.md.
_ram: 24 bytes at 0x7E4FD0A8 (uncached alias 0xBE4FD0A8, PST+104 to PST+127): two log gates and two window keys in the log's state block, cleared at every start by log-menu-3's T_BOOT; 8 bytes at 0x7E4FD300 (uncached 0xBE4FD300, after the log's block buffer, log-movie-time's RAM before): the timer value of the last record pair per command, not cleared at start

ops._note: new code, segment 1 (free part of lss-core's area): T_PS, T_PF, T_PKA, T_PKB, pk_core (288 B)
hook (pana_stat): jmp T_PS + nop. set_stat_pana 0x7E5234D7, entry: `movhu d0,(0x604f88ce)` (the next instruction, btst, sets the flags)
hook (pana_func): jmp T_PF + nop. set_func_flag_pana 0x7E523495, entry: `movhu d0,(0x604f8888)` (then exthu d0, btst)

hook (pana_pk84_0/1): jmp T_PKA + nop + nop + nop. status parser 0x7E523915 (command 84), the read of stat: `mov a2,a0` / `call 0x7E507F65` (a2 = stat in the packet; then exthu d0, call set_stat_pana)

hook (pana_pk34_0/1): jmp T_PKB + nop + nop + nop. status parser 0x7E52128F (command 34), the read of stat after `add 3,a2`: `mov a2,a0` / `call 0x7E507F65` (a2 = stat in the packet; then exthu d0, call set_stat_pana)
flush task, block header: build id bytes 0-3 afe27672 -> 8bf70fea (data/logdict/events.json)
flush task, block header: build id bytes 4-7 d672fc95 -> 0397b1f2 (data/logdict/events.json)
